name: EEB 5050
title: Fundamentals of Ecological Modeling
description: Quantitative inference from ecological and environmental data. Choosing modeling methods based on knowledge of biological processes. Frequentist and Bayesian approaches; analysis of real and simulated data sets.
requirement_description: STAT 1000Q or 1100Q or 3445 or 5005 or 5505; or equivalent with instructor consent.
